tv.welt.ki_welt.text: Every club plans its signings per window, remembers what it spent and which talks failed, and reacts in the next window. Takeovers and crises are rare.
sw.ki_welt.frage: How lively should the transfer market be?
sw.ki_welt.erklaerung: Clubs buy and sell by need, budget and ambition, and remember failed talks.
sw.ki_welt.wirkung: You see more moves around you, rivals for your targets, and clubs that react to what happened before.
sw.ki_welt.hinweis: Works only in PESM until you release other clubs' moves.
sw.drama.erklaerung: Medicals, strikes and contract poker accompany talks and contracts.
sw.drama.wirkung: Deals can collapse at the last moment, players demand talks, and you decide in the inbox.
sw.drama.hinweis: Works only in PESM, nothing of it goes into the game.
sw.ki_trainer.erklaerung: Rival managers change line-up, formation and sliders week by week according to form, squad and results.
sw.ki_trainer.wirkung: The opposition report shows what a manager plans this week; stubborn managers play differently from restless ones.
sw.ki_trainer.hinweis: Works only in PESM until you let the rival line-up be written into the game.
sw.formation.frage: Do clubs shop to fit their formation?
sw.formation.erklaerung: Top clubs look for full-backs, a pair of centre-backs, wingers and strikers to suit their formation.
sw.formation.wirkung: The market gets sharper: clubs buy gaps, not just strength.
sw.formation.hinweis: Works only in PESM until you release other clubs' moves.
sw.identitaet.frage: Should clubs stay true to themselves?
sw.identitaet.erklaerung: Clubs prefer players from their squad's home country and with a fitting age profile.
sw.identitaet.wirkung: Countrymen and young or experienced players end up where they fit.
sw.identitaet.hinweis: Works only in PESM until you release other clubs' moves.
sw.pool.frage: How many players should come onto the market?
sw.pool.erklaerung: Players with up to twelve months left on their contract come onto the market too.
sw.pool.wirkung: More choice in the market and scouting, more movement in the final contract year.
sw.pool.hinweis: Works only in PESM until you release other clubs' moves.
sw.fenster.frage: How picky are clubs about quality?
sw.fenster.erklaerung: Clubs only buy players within ±5 of their budget group's level.
sw.fenster.wirkung: Small clubs do not reach for stars, big clubs do not settle for the average.
sw.fenster.hinweis: Works only in PESM until you release other clubs' moves.
sw.wartet.0: The clubs are talking over the rules of the world …
sw.wartet.1: The transfer market is opening its books …
sw.wartet.2: The directors of football are sorting their notes …
sw.regel_hinweis: Fine rules for how clubs shop.
